mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.household_id, a.institution_id, a.name, a.kind, a.balance_offset, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'income' AND t.account_id = a.id THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'expense' AND t.account_id = a.id THEN -t.amount WHEN t.type = 'transfer' AND t.account_id = a.id THEN -t.amount WHEN t.type = 'transfer' AND t.to_account_id = a.id THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'adjustment' AND t.account_id = a.id THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + a.balance_offset AS balance FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN transactions t ON (t.account_id = a.id OR t.to_account_id = a.id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.household_id = #{householdId} GROUP BY a.id, a.household_id, a.institution_id, a.name, a.kind, a.balance_offset ORDER BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (household_id, institution_id, name, kind) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{institutionId}, #{name}, #{kind})
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET institution_id = #{institutionId}, name = #{name}, kind = #{kind} WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE accounts SET balance_offset = balance_offset + #{delta} WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM accounts WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND id = #{id}
